title: A Tale of Two Cities
synopsis: It was the best of times, it was the worst of times. London and Paris. A doctor recalled from the dead. A daughter. A revolution. A man who looks too much like another.

nodes.text: Carton's name lives, quietly, in your family. Your son, eventually, is named Sydney. He grows up kind. He never quite knows why he is allowed to be.
Lucie lives long. She tells the story to grandchildren by a small fire. The grandchildren, in turn, tell their own.
Dr. Manette returns to medicine. His patients are gentle with him. He sees, for the rest of his days, the shape of a tower no longer there.
